recordedBy: arena-agent (self-review while executing the pipeline stage by stage)

learnings.summary: Master gate clause 'near arm abducted ~15 deg with magenta visible between arm and torso' was NOT honored by the generator (arm rests on torso).
learnings.action: Accepted plate anyway: Stage 3 nearest-bone-axis ownership resolves internal overlap. Next persona prompt strengthens the gap clause; ownership fallback stays mandatory.

learnings.summary: All three atlas poses accepted on first generation (4/8 image-call budget used vs PR #1's 72 full-body calls).
learnings.action: None - validates PIPE-REV P-R2 (atlas-first, pose-local prompts).

learnings.summary: A3 rendered OPEN FLAT hands despite 'closed loose fists' clause (new register candidate IMG-ERR-17).
learnings.action: Both hands re-sourced from A1's closed fists; A3 used only for nearUpperArm + far-leg fold. Prompt register updated in PROPOSAL §7.

learnings.summary: A1 support leg sits slightly behind the hip and A2's trailing knee is more bent than prescribed; both tolerated as texture sources.
learnings.action: None - deviations logged, plates accepted (texture provenance matters more than pose exactness at MVP).

learnings.summary: Eyeballed v1 landmarks were off 20-40 px on several chains (empty nearHand/farThigh windows). Added Stage 2.5 deterministic refiner (run-based slice centroids + PCA axis refit): frame components dropped 3-4 -> 1-2.
learnings.action: Refiner v1 shipped; workbench overlay is the correction UI for residual error.

learnings.summary: Refiner v1 unstable on the master plate: collar/ankle snapped to silhouette contours, foot restLength inflated 16 -> 46 (> shin 29) which broke shoe blitting. Trust-region rejection was tried and also failed (it discards good snaps).
learnings.action: Master keeps visually-verified v1 landmarks; refiner applies to atlas poses only. Follow-up #feat-calib-select: outcome-based bone selection (keep whichever of v1/refined extracts better) + run-selection rewrite, Sprint 1.

learnings.summary: Half-width derived from bone length mismatched pivot caps (pelvis too narrow, limbs too wide). Now measured from the owned pixels' transverse spread per part.
learnings.action: None - kept ratios rose across the board (pelvis 0.07 -> 0.32).

learnings.summary: Hands/feet without compete axes against pelvis/thigh absorbed garment pixels (black capri blob at the rear fist).
learnings.action: Added compete axes [waist,hip],[hip,knee] for hands and [knee,ankle] for feet; residual edge texels remain as DEF-M-01.

learnings.summary: Global master-mean relight target is dragged down by the dark capri tights, pinning every skin part at the 0.85 clamp.
learnings.action: Relight target changed to the matching master region's mean luma per part. Per-material histogram matching deferred to Sprint 2.

learnings.summary: No vertical registration in the first rig pass: figure floated 32-44 px above the ground line on every frame.
learnings.action: MVP shiftToGround per frame (lower sole on ground line). Ballistic flight phase deferred to Stage 6 polish.

learnings.summary: Rendered cycle quality is below PR #1's hand-tuned sprites: empty nearHand, crumpled/detached shoes on swing frames (components 2-3 on 9/16), coarse head-neck seam, shoulder pivot at mid-chest. The architecture executed end-to-end; calibration + ownership refinement is the identified remaining work.
learnings.action: Defects DEF-M-01..05 filed below; adoption decision deferred to the PROPOSAL §11.6 A/B gate (Route B vertical slice vs PR #1 sprites, same rubric).

learnings.summary: Evidence pack filed with the run (contact sheet, per-frame audit, SHA256SUMS, calibration overlays) and surfaced read-only in the workbench.
learnings.action: None - this is the review surface future personas reuse.

defects.summary: Rear-fist part retains dark shorts edge texels despite compete axes.
nearHand part extracts empty (ownership/landmark failure at A1 front fist) - near arm renders handless.
defects.followUp: calibration correction via workbench overlay; outcome-based bone selection

defects.summary: Shoes crumple or detach on swing frames (opaqueComponents 2-3 on 9/16 frames).
defects.followUp: foot canonical orientation + wider ankle pivot cap, Stage 6 polish

defects.summary: Head/neck seam visible on some frames.
defects.followUp: neck part width + skullBase registration tweak

defects.summary: Shoulder pivot sits at mid-chest (collar + 6 px offset), arm swing arc too low.
defects.followUp: per-persona shoulder offset calibration in Stage 2
